food-naxi-grilled-pork.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Naxi-style roasted pork from Lijiang: neatly cut thick slices of roasted pork belly with crisp reddish-golden skin, distinct tender lean meat and pale fat layers, arranged on a simple dark ceramic plate with a few fresh mint leaves and a little side dish of dry ground chili and spice. Roasted freshly cooked pork, no cured ham leg, no kebab skewers, no raw meat and no Western steak sauce.
